Messages.Author: bobby_doc
Messages.Body:
I think it is wonderful if you have a stealth deck.
You put it out and gain four pool.
When you can see the other Metuselahs greedy looks, and just give them
the hard look and explains you just take it back.

But you can also give permission to a Metuselah in trouble...
This card needs you to be good at table diplomacy, and rightly used the
Art Museum really can help you.

Maybe it's not a great card, but absolutly not a Wallpaper.

Rgds

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
A friend <m...@here.com> wrote:
> player a has [HMoAA] out, player b takes another out and they

> contest, did player b get the 4 blood? or lost the four blood?
> in other words if a card comes into play contesting, does it
> become a card at all before it contests?

Well, b either got 4 pool and immediately lost 4 pool for the
contest, or never controlled it in the first place (netting 0).
So mostly it wouldn't matter.

But, since for example playing a second Rack would require you
to choose a minion first (before the contest), it seems as if
player b would gain 4 for playing the card and then lose 4 for
the contest (losing control).

--
